cost: n<=4096 and L<=256. Worst build O(n²(1+L²)), query O(n(1+L²)+k log k), O(nL+n) resident storage; query O(n+k+L) scratch. BTreeMap lookup overhead is bounded by <=256 distance edges. No guaranteed sublinear query.
forward: Insert each word by repeatedly following child edge equal to its byte Levenshtein distance from the node; distance zero appends the original index. Query computes d to each visited node, emits its indexes iff d<=radius, then visits child edges in [saturating(d-radius),saturating(d+radius)]. Sort matches by original index.
